methods.label: Use AM as the base
methods.explanation:
Because \(M\) is the midpoint of \(AD\),
\[
AM=\frac82=4.
\]
Use \(AM\) as the triangle's base. In the rectangle, \(CD\) is perpendicular to the line containing \(AM\), and \(CD=AB=6\). Thus the height from \(C\) is \(6\), even though its foot \(D\) is on the extension of the base. Therefore,
\[
[AMC]=\frac12\cdot4\cdot6
=\boxed{12\text{ square units}}.
\]
The answer is choice \(\text{A}\).
